one_liner_zh: Capri Holdings最新季度財報優於預期，每股盈餘達0.67美元，超出市場預估的0.40美元。
one_liner_en: Capri Holdings reported a strong quarterly beat with EPS of $0.67, surpassing the estimated $0.40, despite a minor revenue decline.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：每股盈餘（EPS）為0.67美元，顯著高於市場預估的0.40美元。
highlights_zh: 每股盈餘（EPS）為0.67美元，優於市場預期的0.40美元。
獲利表現超越預期，顯示成本控制與利潤率管理見效。
本益比維持在17.65倍，估值具備防禦性。
highlights_en: EPS of $0.67 significantly beat the consensus estimate of $0.40.
Profitability outperformed expectations, reflecting effective cost control and margin management.
Trailing P/E ratio stands at 17.65, offering a defensive valuation profile.
risks_zh: 營收較去年同期下滑3.51%至7.69億美元，顯示頂線成長動能仍承壓。
總體經濟環境不確定性可能持續壓抑非必要消費品需求。
risks_en: Revenue decreased by 3.51% year-over-year to $769.0M, indicating ongoing top-line growth pressure.
Macroeconomic uncertainties may continue to weigh on discretionary consumer demand.
ai_view_zh: 觀點：本次財報展現強勁的獲利超預期表現，緩解市場對營收下滑的疑慮。對短中期股價具備正面支撐作用，建議持續追蹤營收成長動能恢復情況及各品牌的零售表現。
ai_view_en: View: The earnings beat provides positive near-term support and alleviates some revenue contraction concerns. Mid-term implications depend on top-line stabilization. Key metrics to track include revenue growth recovery and brand retail performance.
